prior_description: Several H50/H51/H50-B records and the original H53-1 adaptive-lidar slate/report called H36-1 rung30 a tip/step-over surface or tip-family parent.
correction: H36-1 rung30 is an owner-reported 0.2710 H19-5/rung-30 repacking; it is not the explicitly identified tip/step-over family. H33-D is the explicit tip/step-over surface (owner-reported 0.2632). H32-1 is a separate prethin-tip/Euler surface (owner-reported 0.2649).

evidence.observed: H36-1 is described in the owner lineage as an H19-5/rung-30 repacking; H32-1 is separately described as tip/Euler work.
The owner receipt explicitly names H33-D as a tip-protected analog/step-over construction; its primary TIFF SHA is the separate primary_file_sha256 value above.

Owner-reported IDs distinguish h36-1-rung30 (0.2710), h32-1-prethin-tip (0.2649), h33d-tip-stepover (0.2632), and h33-2-b2 (0.2778). The registry itself states these are owner reports, not organizer file-to-score receipts.

impact.h50: Its Dempster arithmetic, source hashes, TIFF bytes, and blocked scores remain tied to B2 x H36-1. Describing that pair as the two best dotted and tip/step-over families was incorrect; do not use H50 as validation of B2 x actual tip/step-over fusion.
impact.h51: Derived from the same B2 x H36-1 H50 fusion; its results are likewise specific to that pair.
impact.h50b: Its radiometric-conflict probe used H36-1-derived conflict corridors; its negative result is not a test of the H33-D tip/step-over family.
impact.h53_legacy_3src_lidar: The already-merged H53-1 three-source adaptive-lidar candidate used B2 x H36-1 rung30 x lidar. Its frozen TIFF, receipt, and scores are unchanged, but it is not a fusion of B2 with the actual tip/step-over family. Do not describe H36 as tip or use this result to claim the requested B2 x H33-D pair was tested.
impact.h53_radedge_1: The separate H53-RadEdge-1 candidate uses B2 x the explicit H33-D tip/step-over surface plus weak GeoDAWN radiometric-edge evidence. It fails its own frozen gate; no slot is cleared.
impact.actual_tip_pair: H33-D is the explicit tip/step-over parent (owner-reported 0.2632); the RadEdge experiment is the current branch’s test of B2 x H33-D. H32-1 is owner-reported slightly higher at 0.2649 but 97.93% of B2 cells overlap it and B2 x H32 was already explored in H48.

no_reinterpretation: H36-1's 0.2710 owner-reported value is not invalidated; only its family classification is corrected.
No claim is made that any H32/H33-D/H36 mirror earned its owner-reported score on the organizer leaderboard without a file-specific receipt.
Separate build pipelines do not establish statistical independence.

legacy_identifier_map.parent_classification: Every H36-1 rung30 reference below means the H19-5/rung-30 repacking, not the actual tip/step-over family.
legacy_identifier_map.handling: These field names persist in frozen H50/H51/H50-B and original H53-3SRC-lidar receipts and compatibility APIs for provenance/schema continuity. In the H50/H51/H50-B and H53-3SRC-lidar records they identify H36-1 rung30 bytes, not the actual tip/step-over family. The separate H53-RadEdge-1 build uses H33-D for the actual tip/step-over parent. Do not infer classification from a legacy key. The original H53-3SRC-lidar TIFF metadata is frozen with its legacy model label; the linked erratum and corrected source-code comments govern interpretation, and the raster was not rewritten.
